title: Canada-based logistics software company Descartes acquires Tai, a California-based transportation management system provider, for $100M in cash (Colin Campbell/Axios)
summary: Colin Campbell / Axios: Canada-based logistics software company Descartes acquires Tai, a California-based transportation management system provider, for $100M in cash — Logistics software giant Descartes has acquired transportation management system provider Tai for $100 million in cash, the companies announced today.
